questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusions logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

All movies are bottles.

Some bottles are steel.

All steel are cupboards.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some movies are bottles.

(II): Some cupboards are steel.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a01e3e742d735a840fda03d628c8f75c9c3969f6ef65bf352db8285ddda6df73.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): Some movies are bottles. → **Follows** (As, All movies are bottles, which implies some movies are bottles is definitely true)

(II): Some cupboards are steel. → **Follows** (As, All steel are cupboards, which implies some cupboards are steel is definitely true)

Hence, ‘Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 20 June of a particular year falls on the 6th day after Tuesday, then what will be the day on 11 August of the same year?
questions.solution:
6th day after Tuesday is Monday.

20 June → Monday

Number of days between 20 June to 11 August = (10 + 31 + 11) = 52

52 when divided by 7, leaves 3 as remainder.

Monday + 3 = Thursday

So, the day on 11 August of the same year will be Thursday.

Hence, ‘**Thursday**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: If 18 September 1998 is Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 15 September 2009?
questions.solution:
An ordinary year has 1 odd day and a leap year has 2 odd days. 

So, the day on the same date for an ordinary year will be 1 day ahead and the day on the same date for a leap year will be 2 days ahead for the next year.

If 18 September 1998 is Friday, then the days on these dates will be:

18 September 1999 → Saturday

18 September 2000 → Monday

18 September 2001 → Tuesday

18 September 2002 → Wednesday

18 September 2003 → Thursday

18 September 2004 → Saturday

18 September 2005 → Sunday

18 September 2006 → Monday

18 September 2007 → Tuesday

18 September 2008 → Thursday

18 September 2009 → Friday

Number of days between 15 September 2009 and 18 September 2009 = 3

Friday - 3 = Tuesday

Clearly, it was Tuesday on 15 September 2009.

Hence, '**Tuesday**' is the correct answer.
